audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] claimed 'Demacian Justice bursts through a low Gwen even inside her Hallowed Mist (W)'. That is backwards.
audit.why: Riot's text: the mist 'protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' Demacian Justice is a single-target cast — from outside the cloud there is no valid target. The player has to walk into the mist to execute her, which is the opposite of what the page told him. Hallowed Mist's cooldown was also given as 16s; it is 22/21/20/19/18.
audit.corrected: Mist restated as untargetability that Garen must enter to beat, with the real 22s/18s cooldown, in spikes[1], whys[4] and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Gwen / Skill / Garen / Garen / Gwen / Skill / Gwen, disagreeing with the mirror on four of seven stages.
audit.why: The mirror (gwen__garen) is already audited and settled on Garen / Garen / Garen / Garen / Skill / Gwen / Gwen. The mirror's own note records that it deliberately did not take the packet's Garen-at-6, so I restate the mirror rather than reopen it — the two directions must not contradict.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to the mirror as one atomic group, with whys[4] and whys[5] rewritten to match the stages they now describe.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] said 'your Stridebreaker spike lands before her Nashor's', which framed first item as Garen's — the mirror gives it to Gwen.
audit.why: Nashor's Tooth turns Skip 'n Slash (E) into on-hit damage that scales with attack speed, so reading the item spike through armour alone misreads the trade. That is the item timing that flips the lane.
audit.corrected: spikes[2] and whys[5] rebuilt on the Nashor's / Skip 'n Slash on-hit spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing tied to A Thousand Cuts, and 'Stack pure HP' sat in Common Mistakes with no reason attached.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts deals bonus magic damage scaled on the target's health and heals Gwen for a portion of it — so stacking raw HP feeds both halves, and her sustain in an extended trade is what beats Garen's grind.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds attached to the passive in dosFull[0]; the reason for not stacking HP written into Common Mistakes.

audit.why: The packet flagged 'Snip Snip' and "Snip Snip's" as probable wrong names. The Riot name is 'Snip Snip!' — the flag is only the missing exclamation mark, a false positive. No name change made on that basis.

notes: Chart aligned to the already-audited mirror rather than to the packet, per the no-contradiction rule; whys[4] and whys[5] were rewritten in the same atomic group so the prose matches the stages. The biggest single fix here is the Hallowed Mist untargetability direction — the page told the player his ultimate reaches her inside the mist when Riot's text says only enemies who enter the mist can target her at all.
